articles.description: Booker learns that she has climbed the all-time college women's basketball scoring ranks and shares how she likes to stay focused while embracing her role as a Texas leader.

articles.headline: Parchment scores 18, No. 23 Illinois women dominate Southern 99-28
articles.description: — Cearah Parchment scored 18 points on 7-of-9 shooting with four 3-pointers and No. 23 Illinois cruised to a 99-28 win over Southern on Saturday.

articles.headline: Grocholski scores 25 points, grabs 11 rebounds, No. 17 Minnesota women top Marquette 87-79
articles.description: — Grace Grocholski hit five 3-pointers and scored 25 points with 11 rebounds; Leah Harmon drained a clutch 3-pointer, and No. 17 Minnesota turned back Marquette 87-79 on Saturday.
